note: Literature confirms congenital hypotonia, muscle weakness, and myopathy are core features of FILIP1-related congenital neuromuscular disorder.

evidence.text: Patients with homozygous FILIP1 variants presented with neurodevelopmental delay, muscle weakness and pathology, dysmorphic features, skeletal deformities, and hypotonia.

source.title: Bi-allelic variants of FILIP1 cause congenital myopathy, dysmorphism and neurological defects
source.quote: Patients exhibit a broad spectrum of neurological symptoms including brain malformations, neurodevelopmental delay, muscle weakness and pathology and dysmorphic features.

evidence.text: FILIP1-related congenital neuromuscular disorder with dysmorphic facies (OMIM #620775) affects muscle development, typically resulting in hypotonia and secondary joint contractures.

source.title: Systematic analysis of homozygous autosomal copy number losses in exomes improves diagnostic yield and uncovers ultra-rare recessive disorders
